_why: NOT a faithful backfill. The link committed as WoaSoloSpecLink.11.2.80 is
invalid and `bot_talents.py audit` fails it: Restoration spends only 3
points in tier 0, so Subtlety, Natural Shapeshifter, Intensity, Omen of
Clarity and Master Shapeshifter are all below their prerequisite and are
silently dropped by PlayerbotFactory at learn time. The conf comment above
that link claims Improved Mark of the Wild 2/2 is bought and it is not --
which is exactly the wire-format drift the recipe warns about, observed in
the wild: a Restoration tier-0 talent moved after the link was authored and
re-pointed every digit after it.
This file restores the stated intent and is valid. The two points come from
Subtlety 3/3 -> 2/3 and Revitalize 3/3 -> 2/3:
Subtlety     is pure threat reduction and worth nothing to a druid
fighting alone. It is kept at 2 rather than 0 only because
Restoration must have 10 points in tiers 0-1 to reach tier 2,
and Improved Mark of the Wild 2 + Nature's Focus 3 +
Natural Shapeshifter 3 leaves exactly 2 to find.
Revitalize   returns resource on Rejuvenation and Wild Growth ticks. It
still works self-cast, so this is a trim rather than a cut.
The tier arithmetic is the constraint, not a preference. PlayerbotFactory
spends the link in (tier, col) order and checks each talent against the
points already spent in that tab, so a build legal in total can still fail
partway through -- which is precisely what the committed link does.
end of each tier against gates of 0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 /
45 / 50. Balance keeps exactly 10 in tiers 0-1, the minimum for Nature's
Splendor.
The build's purpose is unchanged: Bloomstrike 3/3, Gift of Nature 5/5, Gift
of the Earthmother 5/5, Nature's Focus 3/3, Living Spirit 3/3 and Arakkoa
Form, plus Spirit of the Storm 5/5 which the premade build leaves at 0/5 --
without it the solo rotation's Starfire gate never opens and Starfire was
cast zero times in a 360-second measurement.
11 Balance / 60 Restoration.
Empowered Touch stays at 1/2, and counter-intuitively that is the stronger
setting, because PlayerbotFactory applies the wrong rank. Proc diagnostics
(Alonecraft.ProcDebug) show the bot carries the opposite aura to the link in
both cases: with 1/2, rank 2 (33880, 100% chance) persists and rank 1
appears only in the buff burst at combat start; with 2/2, rank 1 (33879,
50%) persists. Measured via Living Spores proc counts over 12 x 360s: 1/2
gives 682 ticks and 2827 DPS, 2/2 gives 437 and 2692. That is a bug in the
talent application, not something to encode permanently -- fix the factory
and revisit, because 2/2 is what the build should want.
